basis: mean-loading match (min permutation/sign-matched |corr| > 0.8) · logp basins (no gap wider than 20 nats between sorted chain logps); Δlogp = mode mean chain logp minus the best mode's

selected_chains.why: User, 2026-10-20: mode A, the best-log-density mode and the one 17 of the 20 chains reach. Its axes: fluid intelligence, scientific knowledge, agentic and cyber merged on one axis, and a visual and commonsense axis; the names were given anew. Integrated LOO was not run: 4_diagnostics/integrated_loo.py takes the exchangeable abilities as N(0, I), not the skew-normal of --theta-skew.

secondary_chains.why: User, 2026-10-20: mode B (chains [0, 1, 18], -8.7 nats below A), kept beside the primary mode for comparison: it holds the previous flagship's structure, with an agentic axis of its own (MirrorCode, OSWorld, FrontierSWE v2).
